question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chief Economic Advisor (CEA) to the Indian government in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venkataramanan Anantha Nageswaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Venkataramanan Anantha Nageswaran** was appointed as the Chief Economic Advisor to the Government of India in 2022.
 
• He succeeded **Krishnamurthy Subramanian** who served as the CEA from 2018 to 2021.
 
• Nageswaran has a strong academic background with a doctoral degree from the University of Massachusetts in Amherst.
 
• He has held various important roles in both academia and the financial sector before his appointment as CEA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Economic Advisor (CEA)**

 
 
• The Chief Economic Advisor (CEA) is a position in the Ministry of Finance, Government of India.
 
• The CEA provides important advice on economic issues to the Government of India.
 
• The role involves the preparation of economic surveys and reports which are used by the government for policy formulation.
 
• CEAs play a crucial role in shaping the economic strategy and policy of the country.
 
 
 
• **Venkataramanan Anantha Nageswaran**
 
 
• Prior to his appointment as CEA, Nageswaran has been a writer, author, teacher, and consultant.
 
• He has taught at various institutions including the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Bangalore and the Singapore Management University.
 
• He has served as the Dean of the IFMR Graduate School of Business and as a part-time member of the Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister of India.
 
• His work spans a wide range of areas including economic policy, financial markets, and corporate finance.
